pull_request.title: Documentation: illustrate the tested staggered Si-W ECAL
pull_request.head: codex/staggered-siw-layout-drawing
pull_request.body:
Provides a reproducible drawing of the Si–W ECAL staggering tested in PR136/137: four barrel phases, the tungsten/silicon sampling stack, full and narrow edge boards, and all four endcap packing families. The 24 mm short-slab adaptation and remaining full-depth sector seams are explicit. DES-030/DES-031 approval states and maintained detector geometry remain unchanged.

![Staggered Si-W layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/15af2785bc795e44b87e64b2c772cb7cb5c737a2/docs/design/figures/DES-031/staggered/staggered-siw-layout.png)

[Vector SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/staggered-siw-layout-drawing/docs/design/figures/DES-031/staggered/staggered-siw-layout.svg). The source, input hashes and reproduction recipe are in `docs/validation/staggered-siw-drawing/README.md`. Regeneration explicitly uses clean source revision `3ebafd340b0e084c5e42e57123de115e3f489244` and the original packing functions; this historical prototype is not substituted into the current detector.

Validation: SVG/PNG regenerate byte-identically; source commit, seven input blobs, recipe hash, dimensions and endcap counts 112/107/110/101 match. Visual inspection, project/inventory/session/interaction validation and token-site build pass locally. Rendering uses pre-existing librsvg 2.62.3; no new native simulation or installation. See the live checks for final-head CI.

The closed drawing turn is recorded once in its original canonical owner: **31 requests /6,726,195 observed tokens** (6,695,693 input +30,502 output). Cached input/reasoning are subsets; this is not a billing estimate. The active merge-preparation turn is excluded. Selected visible request/responses, source fingerprints and usage-only reconciliation evidence are retained. Labels: `documentation`, `campaign:calorimeters`.

This PR packages the requested prototype illustration; merging grants no detector engineering/design acceptance.

events.text: The tested layout repeats four tangential/axial phases: **(0,0), (48,0), (0,48), (48,48) mm**. It uses narrow edge boards to preserve the barrel envelope; the short end slabs use a 24 mm axial shift. I’ll show those details alongside a cutaway through the silicon and tungsten layers.
